notes.title: Zombies Mode Now Available
notes.content:
Greetings and salutations!

Survival Games v0.11.9.0 has been uploaded to early access. This build carries a huge fix list, as well as an entirely new game mode.

https://media.giphy.com/media/iFPAfA8dSDmB96ghY9/giphy.gif

Zombies Mode:

This game mode flips the concept of battle royale upside down, with four players working together to defeat the hordes of undead instead of competing against each other. The game type takes place in the urban confines of City 26, which has been sealed behind walls.

The Dynamic maps from Battle Royale are also present in Zombies Mode. Each time you play, different buildings will be present, or in different states of destruction. Chests with random contents will also appear in semi random locations. Hard to reach places, will have the best tier loot.

https://media.giphy.com/media/L2liHjzrQLMzIlpUO5/giphy.gif

Scenarios:

A scenario is a level, or campaign within the Zombies Mode. Each can start with a different starting set of weapons, and will feature different waves of undead as well as different starting areas.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8226098/e60a5ef2f6b52410c6597b56603fbf38815f2e03.png


The Zombies:

Zombies are best killed with high power rifles, and automatic weapons. Guns are your best friends, but there is a myriad of melee weapons you can also pick up. 

https://media.giphy.com/media/dBCBBmcqi3mlOp8ELg/giphy.gif

There are several varieties of zombies, but Suckers are a nasty little one, that will cling to your face. It's best to have a teammate shoot them off. But if you're alone, you can melee them off as well.

 https://media.giphy.com/media/IcpB28CsukVHc4gg0S/giphy.gif 


Fixes:
This update also carries a lot of fixes and improvements. Please click over here for the full list of changes!

notes.title: Devlog 42: Bots and Multiplayer
notes.content:
Bots are coming to multiplayer, along with improvements to the matchmaking flow of Survival Games. Keep reading to find out what's going on.

Building a community
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8226098/4a2d17c9e15b08b0d98e383820223c5466d30e41.jpg
When the 2014 edition of Survival Games shipped, the Xbox 360 player based simply existed from day one up until the end of XBLIG. Steam is an entirely different animal, so we at 2.0 at working on building up a larger community of active gamers. But it's a chicken and egg problem, where people want more people to play so that they as people can play against the people they need to play. 

Bots Joining You
https://media.giphy.com/media/etB9jJP3axmlGHr2uO/giphy.gif
We are implementing bots as a ramp, to get games going. Bots will join newly created games, providing the minimum players needed to play a round of Battle Royale. They'll also quit games with high player counts, as we want the gamers behind the keyboard to get the satisfaction of kills, not my code.

Bots stealin' yo loot
https://media.giphy.com/media/604fUIG4dv6vHPwfCv/giphy.gif
Survival Games has a lot of game mechanics. Scavenging, killing players, hunting animals and eating are a few of the keys ones. Bots abide by these game mechanics just like players, and can navigate the terrain as well as any player. They are also aware of advanced mechanics such as footprints, and buff characteristics of foods.

Spreading the Word
https://media.giphy.com/media/KY5bqLXQrWhZ0E8GL2/giphy.gif
The most obvious way to grow the multiplayer community, is simply for us to advertise. Go get more people. We're playing the long game with Survival Games, and will only knuckle down on marketing when the game has solved all the technical methods of building a multiplayer community. You'll see gaming events, key give aways and few other things like that later on.

Community members have introduced us to things like SteamGifts, and Woovit which have been helpful! So if you know something, pass it on and we'll use it!

---

Follow Survival Games on Steam to receive notifications on update and events
https://i.imgur.com/1Xe8Iv8.png

https://i.imgur.com/e958TQ1.png
▶ Follow us on Twitter! | https://twitter.com/2point0studios

https://i.imgur.com/iO7aD5Z.png
▶ Chat with us on Discord! | https://discord.gg/DmkqnWk 

Thank you for following and supporting our game!
2.0 Studios

notes.title: Play with Devs #1 is online right now!
notes.content:
We're building up the multiplayer base after Survival Game's launch into early access. Keep reading to learn the best times to play, and how to get a free copies for you or your friends!

The New Kid
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8226098/91772f5f8133c57cb6327d9d9d8f6dcd40bd9aee.jpg
Survival Games is new to early access, having only released a few days ago and Battle Royale games are best with lots of players. This means the multiplayer community is in it's infancy, and we at 2.0 Studios are working to grow it!

Discord Community
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8226098/4d15bf77c020b3dd89953068f164dadd1ed12878.png
Before we hit early access, we ran a private Beta the used our Discord server  as a way to engage with the gamers who play. When we post updates, changelogs and news, this community of 1500 gamers is the first to know. We'll be on the chat channel during our events, if you're keen on having a chat with us.

Bug Hunting
https://media.giphy.com/media/7YCVUme594kxouQkbh/giphy.gif
This game is new, and it's likely there are some issues we have not found yet. This is a great opportunity for the Dev staff check things out, and respond with patches. So while you're here, let us know if you have any trouble or spot anything.

Freebies
 https://media.giphy.com/media/9G55WFDoRAvLfvNJzf/giphy.gif
During these events,  we'll be giving away retail keys  . Later, we will be handing out Steam Inventory Items. Stuff like hats, clothing and other cosmetics. Should be a bit of fun, and cool way to get some free stuff for our gamers.

Regular Events
https://media.giphy.com/media/1k2wsRAWUq9B1MkISr/giphy.gif
Play with Devs is a regular event. So for those of you who own a copy, this is a great time to connect with a larger number of players. We'll be playing Battle Royale mode, but might switch to another mode if you guys want to give that a swing. 

The 2.0 Team
https://media.giphy.com/media/2tQpwTmllixwmJl1mm/giphy.gif
FYI, we're a team of four. Three of us are full time developers, with two programmers and an artist. All three of our dev staff are online for these events. Our Steam Id's are Yado, Mulet_The_Great, 2p0_Studios and Danthekilla.

Thanks for reading, and we hope to see you online!

0.10.4.0 is the current version.

notes.title: Early Access begins NOW
notes.content:
Today is the 10th of April 2018, launch day. As of 10:00pm, you can get a retail copy of Survival Games, at the discounted early access price. What's next? Keep reading to see what's up.

Beta Winding Down:
https://media.giphy.com/media/47KTjR7vs5G3rbOtP2/giphy.gif
1400 beta keys have been given out and used by the Survival Games community. We're going to be closing down the Beta gradually. This means that Beta users, and Retail users will play together for a while as we transition from private Beta to Early Access. This will be complete by the end of April.

About Beta Keys:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8226098/9c8dcb4cbd595cf0424f1dc52ad5d0b917d4cacc.jpg
Beta Keys are not retail keys. They let you play a different version of Survival Games, before the actual launch date. All Beta Keys will all be revoked during April 2018. Consider purchasing Survival Games if you had fun, or want to keep playing. If you got a Steam key from the bot POP-L0ck over on our Discord, then you have a Beta Key. 

About Retail Keys:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8226098/5220c48ac4a01b9dec4f30a7f9b9ff23fbcb0c65.jpg
These keys are permanent additions to your Steam Account. You get these by purchasing Survival Games through Steam. The game modes coming later, are included in your purchase. So you will receive updates for Warfare, Zombie Survival and the Map Editor as the developers complete the milestones.

Milestones and v1.0:
https://media.giphy.com/media/8Z2Zm7X8l1fOZ1jQ0n/giphy.gif
Each game mode, is a different two month milestone. We're launching with Battle Royale as the flagship game mode. Next, is Warfare Mode and after that is Zombie Survival. Finally there is the Map Editor with Steamworks integration. Version 1.0, is when all game modes are in and complete.

Price:
https://media.giphy.com/media/1k2wsRAWUq9B1MkISr/giphy.gif
The full price of Survival Games is $19.95USD, but Early Access means that the game is not finished. So it is discounted to $9.95, with an additional 7 day 25% launch discount on top pushing it down to $7.47 USD

Update Information:
https://media.giphy.com/media/1dIvW3mBHBuCk41koo/giphy.gif
This thread, is filled with posts about what has changed, been added or fixed. You'll also see us on our Discord channel, twitter and the Steam Community hub posting information.

Survival Games began development in 2012. Here it is in 2018, taking its first exciting steps as a Multiplayer Steam game. May the odds be forever in your favour!

notes.title: Devlog 41: Ranged Weapons
notes.content:
Ranged weapons are what you really want to find in Survival Games if you want to be more than first day fodder. Keep reading to learn about four of our favourites.

Battle Rifle
https://imgur.com/QK2yAcj.gif
Medium to long range, with a three round burst. Load this beast up with Medium bullets and prepare to wreck face. Like all guns, there are rarity variants with the rarest blasting off four rounds per burst instead of three. And yes, it is inspired by Halo 2.

Flare Gun
https://imgur.com/gUuOo1x.gif 
Yes I know, it's a nautical tool used to signal help and it's utterly useless in a Battle Royale type game. But it does deal decent damage at range, and start fires. This makes a great distraction, and it's pretty shameful to get finished off by one of these. 

SWAT Pistol
https://imgur.com/n6eHrvg.gif 
When you combine a regular 9199 Operator with an upgrade kit, you get one of these sexy little pieces. They also spawn in locked chests. When you Aim Down Sight (herafter referred to ADS in respect to this secondary function in regards to operation with lethal intent) you get some handy dandy zoom. Oh, and it won't show up a sound marker on the map. Sound markers are something we're adding next update. Woot!

Shotgun
https://imgur.com/YJBny8w.gif
Imagine if Katniss or Shuya got their greasy mits on a shotgun? Eight shells can be loaded in, for some up close mayhem. Scrap blocks can be blown away with impunity, and even bronze chests can be cracked open with a few shots. Have I mentioned that locked chests can just be destroyed to reveal contents?

Well, that’s four guns out of 34 in the game currently. I hope this helps you win. I hope you all win. Every game. I'll be back soon with more helpful info.

 - Jarryd

notes.title: Devlog 40: Tracking for Advanced players + Beta Keys
notes.content:
You can track other players in two ways, but most players don't know how. And we've loaded P0P-L0ck up with more Beta keys. Keep reading for the deets.

Blood
When hurt, all living things bleed. So when you are badly hurt, a bright red trail will be left behind. Crossing rivers and other water can hide the trail, but you really need to heal up. On the flip side, this makes hunting players and fast creatures (like cute bunnies) easier. 

https://imgur.com/g4tUEV4.gif


Footprints
Players leave behind footprints on soft terrain, such as grass. These are subtle dark spots, that can tell you if they are running or walking. Look at the spacing of the footprints. Since creatures also leave footprints behind, I'll be enlisting the help of a Penguin to help demonstrate.

https://imgur.com/WT8SmUB.gif


Tracking
These two combined, make finding weaklings who run away from you quite easy. If you are the hunted however, you should note that hard surfaces such as metals and concrete can't have footprints. However blood will stain anything except water.

https://imgur.com/CFhywPs.gif


More Beta Keys
Over on the 2.0 Studios Discord, our bot has been loaded up with some more Beta keys. So jump onto the #Beta-Keys channel and say "I volunteer as tribute" and POP-L0k will DM you with a Steam key and instructions. 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8226098/65300b61d575162e223d733c58c789dc5fda63be.jpg


Launching into Early Access
So we've run out of show stopping bugs and issues. This means we will have to resort to actually releasing Survival Games into Early Access! After launch, we'll be working with the community to improve and expand the game up to the final version, with all four game modes.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8226098/221e2de5bbfb3d4669ad854597c4f51cd7d44cfc.jpg


Our launch date is April 10, 2018.

Thanks for reading!

notes.title: Devlog 37: Chicken dinner
notes.content:
Survival Games has creatures, lots of wildly different creatures that you can hunt and eat. Read on to learn about some that are in the Beta right now.


http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8226098/c8f5b5e237f99fa53ae8a0315f94e79338b6acef.jpg
Clucky
This humble bird is an excellent source of delicious meat, that can be cooked. These are common, and won't attack you. 

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8226098/771c620368e33877ebce58b9ff77c7d99284517b.jpg
Howler
A vicious member of the Canine family, this grey coated beastie will attack and eat you if it gets the chance. Be careful in forests, as this is their native home.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8226098/38576e6462b72bff0bbe90f1c23116875ebefaae.jpg
Hogger
Unlike it's piggy cousin, the Oinker, this beast is not afraid to attack tributes who get too close. Razor sharp tusks and a mean temperament make these a dangerous encounter if you want to hunt them for their meat.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8226098/408200c77a6b79bc642d26bbdd8713bcf0145fb1.jpg
Skeleton
They say that these were once pirates who had had so much mischeif to do, that death could not stop them. You'll find them around beaches and ruined pirate ships. They carry items left over from their days on the seas, so they carry a wide variety of weapons and items.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8226098/f03df19d218e92318fb31729ab0775fe1326e99e.png
Mushy
This bizarre animated fungus just wants to be left alone. They hide in the ground, and will attack defensively if you get too close. They have some kind of magic about them, and will drop magical items if manage to catch one.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8226098/0a73bb72c8b53247a06a2289c76b43184a006912.jpg
Pixie Pengwing
A tropical relative of the arctic penguins, these flightless birds are found on rocky outcroppings near water. They are harmless, despite their beady red eyes.

There is a bunch more creatures in Survival Games Battle Royale, with the Zombie and Uberhund being unique to the upcoming Zombie Survival mode. Most creatures you encounter have a hostile, and a passive variant which means this list is far from complete.

Creatures add a whole hunting dimension to these Survival Genre games, which clever players can exploit when they kite hostile creatures into fights with their enemies. How? Throw a piece of meat to a deadly Roarclaws and he'll follow you, but not attack you for a while. 

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8226098/36d3baf5d1aea2a8deebaab8424e9e3c86d2dab6.jpg
Anyway, tell us what you think about these in the comments below. Let us know if you have any cool ideas, or noticed something when you encountered one when playing Survival Games.

	- Jarryd

notes.title: Devlog 36 - Where to find loot
notes.content:
In Survival Games, loot is essential to your survival. In this post, I'll be covering the many different ways you can get your gear in Survival Games.


Wooden Chests
These common chests have decent gear such as melee weapons or a gun. You can tell if one has been opened, so you don't have to run into danger to check.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8226098/d5bae9be0acd5b3d0c537fbdc7dad6fde22d4970.png

Gold, Silver and Bronze Chests 
These ones have better gear, like a legendary sniper rifle. But you'll need to find Bronze, silver or Gold keys to open them. Lockpicks will also open these, but will take a long time, so be careful. 

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8226098/56bde6b1dad134e451950adf03cc66a15670d967.jpg

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8226098/8fec681504c4d8a0457480af668034569535c099.jpg

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8226098/7384f38cecc425fb2b0a42db7f1e595a79707e2a.jpg

Timed Chests
These rare beauties have similar contents to Gold chests. But they unlock at a specific time after you interact with them. If you find one, that's already counting down, there is probably someone nearby waiting…

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8226098/65e96b9f06d748aced188919b4c977929b08e0a7.png

Spawners
You'll also find guns, ammo, food and crafting supplies just lying around in the wilderness or in houses. These come from spawners, which are randomly placed and have random contents.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8226098/354d184c25bb5804fa108a273df7d47fd3569383.jpg

Drop Pods
These fall from the sky randomly, and hit the ground with a bang. They can contain anything, from legendary guns down to common foods. Don't let them hit you on the way down!

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8226098/c17795b6e6b67683bc04a1806216788783f7ca2e.png

Trees and Forage
Up in trees, you can find apples, voxel nuts and cherries! Hold down interact and the fruit will fall from the tree. There are others, so keep an eye out!

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8226098/6346178f229f7a33540cbdea6dba49c453b3585d.jpg

Cupboards, crates and Fridges
Open the fridge, and you can get foods. There are also crates found in huts, and cupboards in houses. They take a moment to open, which can make you vulnerable.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8226098/5a473a6d4ca07b9273365144f4505ca1e8712fc6.jpg

Creatures
Slaying creatures gives you items. Chickens, pigs, even wolves give you meat. Some will fight back, like the Boars! There are also monsters, like skeletons and zombies. These guys are tough, but will drop items like swords or crafting supplies.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8226098/b041c5f9d2da35ecfc27c9775e25b8e179c85aa4.png

Perks
So there is a perk called "looter" that will give you extra stuff when you search chests. There are other perks that will also give you gear.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8226098/875c0fb72c4e983895f61d454a49c81e34727888.jpg

Other Players
The best place to find awesome gear, is of course from other players. When they die, everything gets dropped into the world for you to scavenge.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8226098/17a5cb0613f48725264fdd3180783959aabb95b6.jpg

Armed with this knowledge, you can get a lot more out of each game than those that don't know. So go ahead, and wreck some face with those shotgun shells everyone else overlooked!

- Jarryd

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8226098/d5bae9be0acd5b3d0c537fbdc7dad6fde22d4970.png

Gold, Silver and Bronze Chests 
These ones have better gear, like a legendary sniper rifle. But you'll need to find Bronze, silver or Gold keys to open them. Lockpicks will also open these, but will take a long time, so be careful. 

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8226098/56bde6b1dad134e451950adf03cc66a15670d967.jpg

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8226098/8fec681504c4d8a0457480af668034569535c099.jpg

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8226098/7384f38cecc425fb2b0a42db7f1e595a79707e2a.jpg

Timed Chests
These rare beauties have similar contents to Gold chests. But they unlock at a specific time after you interact with them. If you find one, that's already counting down, there is probably someone nearby waiting…

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8226098/65e96b9f06d748aced188919b4c977929b08e0a7.png

Spawners
You'll also find guns, ammo, food and crafting supplies just lying around in the wilderness or in houses. These come from spawners, which are randomly placed and have random contents.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8226098/354d184c25bb5804fa108a273df7d47fd3569383.jpg

Drop Pods
These fall from the sky randomly, and hit the ground with a bang. They can contain anything, from legendary guns down to common foods. Don't let them hit you on the way down!

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8226098/c17795b6e6b67683bc04a1806216788783f7ca2e.png

Trees and Forage
Up in trees, you can find apples, voxel nuts and cherries! Hold down interact and the fruit will fall from the tree. There are others, so keep an eye out!

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8226098/6346178f229f7a33540cbdea6dba49c453b3585d.jpg

Cupboards, crates and Fridges
Open the fridge, and you can get foods. There are also crates found in huts, and cupboards in houses. They take a moment to open, which can make you vulnerable.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8226098/5a473a6d4ca07b9273365144f4505ca1e8712fc6.jpg

Creatures
Slaying creatures gives you items. Chickens, pigs, even wolves give you meat. Some will fight back, like the Boars! There are also monsters, like skeletons and zombies. These guys are tough, but will drop items like swords or crafting supplies.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8226098/b041c5f9d2da35ecfc27c9775e25b8e179c85aa4.png

Perks
So there is a perk called "looter" that will give you extra stuff when you search chests. There are other perks that will also give you gear.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8226098/875c0fb72c4e983895f61d454a49c81e34727888.jpg

Other Players
The best place to find awesome gear, is of course from other players. When they die, everything gets dropped into the world for you to scavenge.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8226098/17a5cb0613f48725264fdd3180783959aabb95b6.jpg

Armed with this knowledge, you can get a lot more out of each game than those that don't know. So go ahead, and wreck some face with those shotgun shells everyone else overlooked!

- Jarryd

notes.title: Devlog 34 - Beta now open, Get your key
notes.content:
The Survival Games Battle Royale beta is now open. Speak to our Discord bot, POP-L0CK to request a beta key. More detail within.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8226098/718da33ec777fb8bc39c78bcfdaf249439afb37b.png

You will need a Beta key to access the Beta, and these are free. Over on our Discord channel, I've written a bot that can hand them out. Say this to the Bot:

@POP-L0K I volunteer as tribute

He'll DM you a key, and the instructions on how to use it.

This is a small Beta, and we want to work closely with those of you who participate. Multiplayer will be turned off from time to time, if we find a huge bug or just want to consolidate our users into one session with a higher player count.

The very first thing we want to find out, is if it installs and launches correctly on your machine. As most PC gamers know, every gaming rig is a unique set of parts and software. Sure Survival Games runs on our dev machines and test rigs, but does it run on your gaming PC? Let us know!

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8226098/91772f5f8133c57cb6327d9d9d8f6dcd40bd9aee.jpg

See you guys online!
 - Jarryd

notes.title: A Delay!
notes.content:
We're now launching December 28!

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8226098/350e72ada7dfe2d1e233b2733aa7f053bb68b798.png

2.0 Studios has been making games for over eight years now, but this is our very first Steam game. We misunderstood the submission process, and accidentally delayed our own game. 

Right now, Survival Games is in the first review stage. Our mistake was not doing this one month ago when we were showing Survival Games off at PAX Melbourne. This means that Survival Games won't spend long as a "coming soon" game, and will have launch date later than expected while we wait for the Valve team to do their thing.

The silver lining, is that we now have the time to run a Beta. Access keys will be issued via our Discord Server from our custom Discord Bot, POP-L0k. This Beta will run in the time before the game launches into Early Access, beginning in the next few days.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8226098/4d15bf77c020b3dd89953068f164dadd1ed12878.png

I'm sorry for the delay, and hope that you'll give the Beta a shot in the meantime.

Thank you for reading!
 - Jarryd

notes.title: Devlog 29 - Zombies, tributes and PAX
notes.content:
Survival Games will be coming to Early Access on December 7, 2017

Since the time of our last writing, Survival Games has undergone a massive transformation. It includes not just one mode of play, but four. There is also now 8 maps instead of one.

If you're one of the cool kids heading off to PAX Melbourne next weekend, you can check us out in the PAX Rising section where we will be running four player rounds of Survival Games!

So let's break down the game modes this fantastic new build of Survival Games has:

BATTLE ROYALE MODE:
This is the flagship gametype. Inspired by the 2000 movie of the same name, and the Hunger Games movie/book series, it pits a dozen players against one another in a brutal fight to the death. Large sections of the map change each time you play, and loot is randomly placed so that you can never memorise and own the world. And at the end? The dome shrinks. Take THAT campers!
https://i0.wp.com/www.CraftWorldGame.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/10/Gladiator.jpg 


ZOMBIE MODE:
Co-operative Survival is the meaning of this gametype. City 26 has been overrun by the hordes of the dead that you must fend off. As each day passes, they grow more powerful and numerous. Delve into the sewers, through the locked doors and be rewarded with the best gear. But beware, the foulest undead creatures love the dark and winding corridors.
 https://i1.wp.com/www.CraftWorldGame.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/10/Zombies.jpg


ARENA MODE:
Fast paced in your face shooter gameplay inspired by the greatest first person shooters of all time. In Deathmatch, collect weapons from the map and blow each other away. Many maps are tributes to legendary first person shooter games such as Halo, Unreal Tornament and Counterstrike. But remember, this is a block game. Terrain will be destroyed, and scorched a myriad of different colors as your play.
https://i1.wp.com/www.CraftWorldGame.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/10/BeaverCreek.jpg 


MAP EDITOR:
Build your own maps block by block. Take the base maps this ships with, modify and invite your friends to try out your wicked new changes. Name nodes, weather controllers, creature spawners and more await builders. 


DOUBLE MULTIPLAYER
We're also offering two different multiplayer modes. Steamworks for online play, with a quick and easy search and join system. Keep your games private, boot the fools or just drop into new public games whenever you are slain.

Local Network Play, does not rely on an internet connection. Lightning fast, and lag free the way you're dad's shooters used to be. This is perfect for those of you who attend public LANS or simply invite a few mates over for the weekend. We at 2.0 love LAN gaming, and deem this essential to a true multiplayer game.


SINGLE PLAYER:
Survival Games is multiplayer game, that is without a doubt. Gamers who just want some alone time should know that without other players, creatures and the elements still make for incredible opposition. Fending off Zombies for days in game, or simply lasting as long as you can in the Arena by hunting food and building shelter keeps this game engaging. Oh, and you can always just burn a dozen hours building stuff if that's more your speed too.
https://i1.wp.com/www.CraftWorldGame.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/10/steven.png


Follow us, and let us know what you think as Survival Games makes the push into Early Access and beyond!

Thank you for reading!
 - Jarryd
